HANDOVER — CURRENT STATE, measured 2026-09-01 06:12Z. This canonical summary replaces post-01M16NZT53CWE1D1R57TZWB7NF.

AUTHORITY. docs/CONSTITUTION.md Article X says appointment belongs to the human owner; the record makes succession cold-startable, not self-starting. The owner appointed codex-storymodel4s-chief in post-01M1C72VF6TS2RJGRPQX2936QE and in the current owner/chief session. Silence, lease state, and actor labels do not confer authority. Unappointed coordinators remain limited to reversible coordination.

OWNER SCOPE. The top product and scientific priority is a sound, uncertainty-aware, visualizable mapping from a recall transcript to a film such as Sherlock. Raw video files or bytes must not enter repository storage; other Sherlock-derived artifacts may be stored and shared under ordinary provenance and admission controls. AMR runtime inclusion is owner-authorized.

REPOSITORY. Shared checkout is main at 56c38ebeed870c1f97b46868e0d86961296028ea, 151 commits ahead and zero behind the local origin/main ref 7385cf9379e59599d1e18370049ac73782844816. The worktree is materially dirty with 37 porcelain entries, including 11 tracked modifications. No current clean-tree, full-green, pushed, or live-remote claim is established. Disk is 95 percent used with 45 GiB available. Preserve unrelated edits and use explicit staging.

MOTE. Fsck is clean at 12,330 operations. The critical recovery is committed locally in the Rust repository: legacy evidence identity repair 1451f115f6f4e607720320b302f83e8c6437e53c and audited recovery protocol 85a0cc7a01bb3b12d4e4fd26a6ca1cb82c115672. Independent review APPROVE is commit-bound; 367 all-feature tests passed with zero failures and one intentional performance ignore. Installed binary SHA-256 is a9f0b96047aadd422ffa01b6f12e22f83a387eddb8535931898f7f50bcaf800b. The repair bead is closed; the review gate remains open pending non-force push, live remote SHA, and hosted CI. The broader append-only candidate-pair convergence defect remains bd-01M1DPXZGDWZXT1ZDN6683AZA2.

CURRENT SCIENCE AND PRODUCT GATES.
- CODE RED topic recall-construction-scientific-boundary has substantive convergence but no adopted decision. Its claimed self-contained PRD omits the narrowed R3.1; the correction exists only in a descendant post and the named plan file is absent. The durability hold is correct. Q-B remains owner-level corpus, adjudication, ethics, and REB work. The chief comments are nonbinding.
- Sherlock B0R is machine-landable as cand-6XWW93XPEQEP8WQP6HXRF9B2E6 at e0c884bafa1f20157dfe68a110cccaf66119ca26. C1 waits for its recorded landing.
- P1A AMR preflight established that the pinned runtime produces checked PENMAN but no token-alignment markers. Runtime inclusion is authorized; the remaining ruling is whether typed AlignmentMissing satisfies the execution witness or whether an aligner slice is required.
- Output successor aa2b04c32f348e2e5bb80b49ee5dad642b64d292 remains at a clean pre-proposal boundary awaiting independent replay.
- Support-honesty successor cand-6AAPYS0RBRFQNFWSXVC66J14SQ at b33fe5b remains registered but lacks both required reviews and authorization and retains its declared infrastructure and documentation dependencies.
- Astro guide successor de9265cf584f2b27a1e45014549f279798c68792 is fully gated and ready for registration. Scout currently protects docs-site; durable documentation ownership remains unassigned.
- Paused, stale, expired, or orphaned labels are not proof that an actor or workstream is abandoned. Check recent operations and ask before reassignment.

CANDIDATE QUEUE. Live replay reports 38 pending and exactly five landable: cand-0PQXDW41WY6Q9Z1QE97W4J7ZTS reference-scope repair; cand-5T2Q65J8XRARDYYYPKP5FPB2AZ nomination-provenance court; cand-6CW0BXWTDXFF4VKHXKAS49M3AP posterior-flow visualization court; cand-6XWW93XPEQEP8WQP6HXRF9B2E6 Sherlock B0R; and cand-7KHF208ZYCJRX4D06R2BS4HWAQ cell-construction probes. The first four grant the current chief; cand-7KHF grants only claude-storymodel4s and claude-storymodel4s-m1 and must remain parked absent a lawful remedy.

The 28 authorization_absent rows are not an authorization queue. Only cand-0J2GM6VA924RTNSB7EBD0HSXYX at 1e5df7aeaf6b6624764c6ca5de48119d72f91ff5 is verified as fully reviewed and awaiting only its immutable authorizer, codex-cli-vertical-slice. Existing exact request is msg-01M1DJ01H6Q6JVJG37HE914P3N. Do not bulk-authorize and do not route around that authorizer.

SAFE ORDER. First obtain the exact named authorization and land cand-0J2, the premerge checker repair. Then re-show every candidate, run the mechanized premerge gate, and land reference-scope, nomination, posterior-flow visualization, and Sherlock B0R, recording each landing immediately. Re-read live CAS and reservations inside every gate window; never reuse this summary as current authorization evidence. Keep cand-7KHF parked. After the queue moves, register and independently review the Astro successor, advance the output successor, and continue Sherlock P1A and recall-to-film integration.
